description: Flat record-level metadata schema for sequencing microbial genomes from high-volume urban air samples, including sampling context, weather, location, and sequencing metadata.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record/sample. Example: 'UAS_2025_00123'.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to a study or campaign. Example: 'UrbanAirMicrobiome_2025'.

site_id.descr: Unique identifier for the sampling location/site.

site_category.descr: Urban land-use category of the site. Controlled values may include 'park', 'industrial_zone', 'residential_area', 'commercial_area', 'roadside', 'mixed_use'.

city.descr: City where the sample was collected.

region_state_province.descr: Administrative region, state, or province of the sampling site.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level in meters.

sampling_time_local.descr: Local time of sample collection, ideally in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS). Stored as string because time-only type is not available.

time_of_day.descr: Time-of-day category for collection. Example values: 'morning', 'afternoon', 'evening', 'night'.

season.descr: Season during sample collection. Example values: 'spring', 'summer', 'autumn', 'winter'.

day_night_flag.descr: Whether the sample was collected during daytime (true) or nighttime (false).

sampling_campaign.descr: Name or code for the field campaign or sampling round.

sampling_device_type.descr: Type of high-volume air sampler used.

sampling_device_model.descr: Manufacturer model or instrument model of the air sampler.

sampling_flow_rate_l_min.descr: Average airflow rate during sampling in liters per minute (L/min).

sampling_duration_h.descr: Duration of air collection in hours.

total_air_volume_m3.descr: Total volume of air sampled in cubic meters (m^3).

particle_size_fraction.descr: Particle size fraction collected, if size-selective sampling was used. Example: 'PM2.5', 'PM10', 'total suspended particles'.

collection_medium.descr: Material or medium used to capture airborne particles, such as filter type or impinger fluid.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size in micrometers (µm), if applicable.

filter_material.descr: Filter or capture substrate material. Example: 'PTFE', 'quartz fiber', 'polycarbonate'.

sample_preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample after collection. Example: 'frozen at -80C', 'RNAlater', 'dry ice transport'.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius after collection and before processing.

dna_extraction_kit.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation method used for sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used. Example: 'Illumina NovaSeq', 'Oxford Nanopore MinION'.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads generated for this record.

quality_filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality filtering.

assembly_method.descr: Assembly software or approach used to reconstruct genomes/contigs.

genome_bin_id.descr: Identifier for a genome bin, MAG, or assembled microbial genome associated with this record, if applicable.

taxonomic_assignment.descr: Primary taxonomic assignment for the genome or sequence record, if available.

taxonomic_rank_assigned.descr: Taxonomic rank used for the assignment. Example values: 'species', 'genus', 'family', 'phylum'.

proximity_green_space_m.descr: Distance from sampling site to the nearest green space in meters.

proximity_pollution_source_m.descr: Distance from sampling site to the nearest major pollution source in meters. Example sources: traffic corridor, industrial stack, waste facility.

nearest_pollution_source_type.descr: Type of nearest pollution source. Example values: 'road traffic', 'industrial emission', 'construction site', 'waste treatment', 'shipping port'.

air_temperature_c.descr: Air temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity_pct.descr: Relative humidity at sampling time in percent (%).

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling time in meters per second (m/s).

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction in degrees from north (0-360).

precipitation_mm_h.descr: Precipitation rate during sampling in millimeters per hour (mm/h).

cloud_cover_pct.descr: Cloud cover during sampling in percent (%).

air_pressure_hpa.descr: Atmospheric pressure during sampling in hectopascals (hPa).

pm2_5_ug_m3.descr: Fine particulate matter concentration (PM2.5) in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m^3), if measured.

pm10_ug_m3.descr: Coarse particulate matter concentration (PM10) in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m^3), if measured.

controls_included.descr: Whether field or laboratory controls were included for this record or sampling batch.

replicate_number.descr: Technical or biological replicate number for the sample record, if applicable.

human_activity_context.descr: Optional descriptor of nearby human activity at the time of sampling, such as 'low', 'moderate', 'high', or a standardized exposure context.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on deviations, unusual conditions, or additional context relevant to the record.
